tools_helpful.evidence: Caught residual MIGRATION-MAPPING rows stuck at Status=copied and ran the rebuild + smoke-launch gates (turns 46-55), driving the agent to a clean PASS.
Surfaced the real Appx registration failure (0x80080204 / 0x80073CF6) from the background-task manifest extension at turns 51-54, telling the agent exactly why launch failed.

tools_problematic.problem: Copy step pulled stale UWP build output (obj/, bin/, Tasks/obj, Tasks/Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs) into the target because it copies every *.cs recursively with no bin/obj exclusion.
tools_problematic.evidence: turn 29 build: 'Tasks\obj\x64\Release\.NETCore,Version=v5.0.AssemblyAttributes.cs(4,12): error CS0579: Duplicate TargetFrameworkAttribute'; agent had to Remove-Item the stale folders at turn 31. Also produced 208 MIGRATION-MAPPING rows incl. bin\x64\Debug\AppX\Assets\*.png.

tool_limitations.limitation: Namespace-rewrite step excludes bin/obj/.uwp-source (line 106) but the earlier file-copy step (line 69) does not, so build artifacts leak into the migrated tree.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Apply the same exclude-dir filter to the copy loop; also skip legacy Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs (SDK-style projects auto-generate assembly attributes).

failed_apis.why_tried: UWP App.xaml.cs dispatched in-process background tasks by overriding OnBackgroundActivated.
failed_apis.root_cause: Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Application has no OnBackgroundActivated to override and BackgroundActivatedEventArgs is not in scope in the WinUI 3 app model.
failed_apis.fix: Removed the override entirely (turn 37); in-process background activation is not part of the WinUI 3 Application lifecycle.

failed_apis.why_tried: UWP manifest registered the in-process task via <Extension Category="windows.backgroundTasks" EntryPoint="...">.
failed_apis.root_cause: Without an ActivatableClassId/inProcessServer registration the appx manifest is invalid (0x80080204); with no EntryPoint the extension is rejected (0x80073CF6) — the package will not register or launch.
failed_apis.fix: Removed the windows.backgroundTasks extension from the manifest and wrapped BackgroundTaskBuilder.Register() in try/catch (turn 52).

special_apis.special_handling: The sample project/folder is named 'ActivitySensor', identical to the WinRT type it demos, so RootNamespace=ActivitySensor shadowed the type → CS0118. Required <RootNamespace>SDKTemplate</RootNamespace> + moving App/MainWindow to namespace SDKTemplate + dotnet clean to regenerate XamlTypeInfo.g.cs.

errors_encountered.root_cause: Bootstrap copied the UWP project's stale obj/ and Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs; the auto-generated SDK assembly attributes then collide with the copied ones.
errors_encountered.fix: Deleted the stale Tasks\obj and Tasks\Properties folders (turn 31).

errors_encountered.error: CS0118: 'ActivitySensor' is a namespace but is used like a type
errors_encountered.root_cause: Project RootNamespace equals the WinRT type name ActivitySensor; references to the type bind to the project namespace instead.
errors_encountered.fix: Set <RootNamespace>SDKTemplate</RootNamespace>, moved App/MainWindow/scenario pages to namespace SDKTemplate, then dotnet clean + rebuild to regenerate XamlTypeInfo.g.cs (turns 43-45).

errors_encountered.error: CS0246 'BackgroundActivatedEventArgs' not found / CS0115 OnBackgroundActivated no suitable method to override
errors_encountered.root_cause: WinUI 3 Application has no in-process background-activation override.

errors_encountered.error: WMC0909 'Cannot resolve DataType local:Scenario' / WMC1111 DataTemplate with x:Bind needs x:DataType
errors_encountered.root_cause: DataTemplate used x:Bind with x:DataType pointing at local:Scenario, which failed to resolve under the renamed namespace.
errors_encountered.fix: Switched the DataTemplate to classic {Binding Title} (turn 37).

errors_encountered.error: Appx register failed 0x80080204 / 0x80073CF6 at smoke launch
errors_encountered.root_cause: windows.backgroundTasks manifest extension with an in-process EntryPoint is invalid in the WinUI 3 packaging model.
errors_encountered.fix: Removed the extension from Package.appxmanifest; registration moved to runtime BackgroundTaskBuilder in try/catch (turns 52-54).

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Repeated CS0118 'ActivitySensor is a namespace but is used like a type'; survived an App/MainWindow namespace move AND a RootNamespace edit and only cleared after dotnet clean.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Project named after the WinRT type it demonstrates; stale XamlTypeInfo.g.cs kept the old namespace after the RootNamespace edit.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: RootNamespace -> SDKTemplate + dotnet clean to regenerate XamlTypeInfo.g.cs.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A documented CS0118 build-error pattern telling the agent (a) rename RootNamespace to the neutral SDKTemplate namespace when the project name collides with a WinRT type and (b) dotnet clean afterwards.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: CS0579 duplicate assembly attribute from a copied obj/ folder.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Initialize copy step copied UWP bin/obj/Properties artifacts.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Excluding bin/obj/Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs in the bootstrap copy loop (Tier-1).

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Sequential CS0246/CS0115 build errors then two Appx registration failures at launch.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: WinUI 3 has no OnBackgroundActivated override and rejects the windows.backgroundTasks manifest extension used by UWP in-process tasks.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Removed the override and the manifest extension; wrapped Register() in try/catch.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Expanding the Background Tasks pattern to spell out: remove OnBackgroundActivated, remove the windows.backgroundTasks manifest extension, guard Register() with try/catch.

env_issues.issue: winapp smoke-launch could not register the package while the manifest carried the windows.backgroundTasks extension.
env_issues.workaround: Removed the extension; subsequent launch reported status=running.
